title: Authorize Customer Payment
story: As a customer, I want my payment to be authorized securely so that my order can be confirmed.

title: Receive Payment Failure Notification
story: As a customer, I want to be notified when my payment fails so that I can take corrective action.

title: Prevent Duplicate Payments
story: As a customer, I want duplicate payment requests to be prevented so that I am not charged more than once.

title: Retry Failed Payment
story: As a customer, I want to retry an eligible failed payment so that I can complete my purchase.

title: Confirm Order After Payment
story: As a customer, I want my order to be created only after successful payment authorization so that order status remains accurate.

title: Track Transaction Status
story: As a support user, I want to view the current payment transaction status so that I can assist customers.

title: Process Refund
story: As an authorized business user, I want to process full or partial refunds so that eligible customer payments can be returned.

title: Validate High Risk Payments
story: As a risk analyst, I want high-risk transactions to be validated before completion so that fraudulent transactions can be reduced.

title: Notify Customer After Payment Failure
story: As a customer, I want to receive a notification after a payment failure so that I know the transaction was unsuccessful.

title: Search Transactions
story: As an authorized business user, I want to search transactions by multiple identifiers so that I can quickly investigate payment activity.
